description: The 65536-email cap for collapseThreads=true queries, combined with returning total=null when capped, is the correct RFC 8620 §5.5 behavior. The comment (lines 13-18 in email.rs) explains the OOM rationale and the 2MiB bound. A contributor might want to remove the cap or always return a total. Resist: without the cap a hostile client can OOM the server; returning a fictional total when the result is capped would mislead clients.
title: COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS cap and honest total=null are correct
